items.text: With old offers, device records, host keys and a residual Keychain item, a new app installation starts unpaired. Old credentials grant no access. A new QR enrolls the phone. Read prior DSH sessions and page across old and new pairing, revocation and approval records with no gaps or duplicates. `cmd:scripts/pnpm-test`, `cmd:scripts/demo/tls-upgrade.sh` **new**

All phone–bridge network paths use TLS 1.3. Built-product and listener checks catch legacy code, cleartext and broad ATS exceptions. Same-key renewal occurs before expiry. Old QRs and changed keys fail closed with recovery instructions. `cmd:scripts/check-release-clean`, `cmd:scripts/demo/tls-upgrade.sh`

Swift, bridge and protobuf checks pass. Installation instructions cover update order, fresh enrollment, same-key renewal and changed-key recovery. The shipped CLI and migrated demos work with that procedure. `cmd:scripts/swift-test`, `cmd:scripts/pnpm-test`, `cmd:scripts/codegen --check`, `cmd:scripts/demo/check-tls-demos.sh`

From a fresh install, read a pre-existing host session, dispatch, fall back to a second address, replay missed events and revoke through both existing management screens. `cmd:scripts/demo/tls-upgrade.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/revoke.sh`
